title: Open documents without waiting for the whole file
description: Documents are streamed, so one appears from its first page while the rest is still arriving. An interrupted transfer resumes where it stopped, and a document that has not changed is confirmed as unchanged rather than sent again. A name containing a space, a comma or an accent is no longer altered when the file is saved, and more kinds of file can be read in the browser instead of only downloaded: .txt, .md, .xml and .csv, video, and images such as .webp, .gif, .bmp and .tiff.
